kind: motion curves: animated empties only (no meshes, no materials); the runtime applies each child empty's local transform to a real part (src/holm_island_anim.js)

clips.name: Fall
clips.desc: felled oak: creak, topple toward +Z (gravity), bounce, lie, sink; stepped 15/s

clips.name: CastOff
clips.desc: the skiff pushes off east, then pulls out north to the open sea; plank slides aboard first

clips.name: Swing
clips.desc: the ferry bell rung three times and dying away; about glTF X from its hanging point; stepped 15/s

clips.name: Drop
clips.desc: the tied rope pays out down the shaft: scale glTF Y from the knot 0.04 -> 1.06 -> 1; stepped 15/s

clips.name: Open
clips.desc: a door swings open: 0 -> 94 -> 90 deg about glTF Y; stepped 15/s

clips.name: Close
clips.desc: a door swings shut: 90 -> 0 deg, a knock on the latch (4 deg rebound); stepped 15/s

clips.name: Pump
clips.desc: the bellows squash (0.7) and fill again, scale glTF Y from the base; loops; stepped 15/s

clips.name: Flicker
clips.desc: a torch flame: height 0.82-1.16, width 0.9-1.08, a small lean; loops; stepped 15/s
